answer: An agent economy can require each account to lock scarce tokens as stake before submitting jobs or claiming rewards. If an audit finds linked identities faking demand, the protocol slashes their stake and limits their influence. A sybil attacker must buy and immobilize capital for every account, risking its loss; creating identities is no longer free. A ripple of checks can spread from a wharf to linked accounts, though honest newcomers may bend like a willow under the added burden.
